verdict.rationale: The pack documents automatic KV-cache memory management via PagedAttention and prefix caching. Nothing shows a user-facing control for how context (KV-cache) memory is allocated, and nothing covers running multiple model instances concurrently on shared hardware. Automatic internal memory management is an adjacent feature, not the user control this story asks for, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
